title: Process PR #571 — Fix the empty JSX text token between two child elements

# Dough Intent Coverage

**Story:** SEED-059#process-pr-571-jsx-empty-text-token
**Revision:** 60b2fb5933112ddab2bd540cd29236cd5ec3951b
**Promise:** Adjacent JSX child elements emit no empty text token, so `-Eduplicate` does not raise `IndexError` and token counts stay correct.
**Fault:** Reverted `XMLTagWithAttrTokenizer.flush` to treat only whitespace (`text.isspace()`), restoring empty-string token emission between sibling elements.
**Fixture/assertion:** `test_element_right_after_a_child_element` and `test_slash_in_text_does_not_open_a_regex` in `test/test_languages/testTSX.py`.
**Outcome:** Caught. Baseline green (2 passed); with the fault both tests failed (empty `''` token / Rates token count 47 vs 45); CLI `-Eduplicate` on `panel.tsx` raised `IndexError`; restoration returned green and a clean scratch tree.
